homepage.body:
ONLINE SERVICES

FOR MEMBERS
FOR EMPLOYERS
FOR DEVELOPERS
MEMBERSHIP
Please click the image to avail of the service.
Membership Registration
Get your permanent Pag-IBIG Fund Membership ID (MID) Number here.
Pag-IBIG HOUSING LOAN
Please click the image to avail of the service.
Pag-IBIG Housing Loan Application
Take your first step in applying for a Pag-IBIG Housing Loan, online!
Developer's Online Housing Loan Application
Accredited developers may submit the Pag-IBIG Fund Housing Loan applications on behalf of prospective borrowers here.
OTHER SERVICES
Please click the image to avail of the service.
Online Payment Facility via Virtual Pag-IBIG
Pay your loans and save with Pag-IBIG via our Virtual Pag-IBIG here.
MP2 Enrollment System
Enroll in our MP2 Savings to start saving and earning higher annual dividends here.
Electronic Submission of Remittance Schedule (eSRS)
Employers can now submit their monthly remittance schedules online through this facility.
